ref: verifier agent prompt: Testing Protocol §2 supported_fail routing table
what: The routing table covers OOM / numerical-precision / numerical-bug / hang / compilation, but not a raw NotImplementedError regime refusal (a predicate-guarded resident fast-path that refuses shapes outside its L1 residency domain, sanctioned by blocking-model / l1-footprint docs). Only SupportRefusal is xfailed on out-of-SUPPORTED cells, so once a refinement widens SUPPORTED, such a cell reads as supported_fail. I had to infer it is OOM-class (keep failing, do not EXCLUDE).
suggest: Add a row: regime-refusal NotImplementedError on an in-SUPPORTED cell = resource boundary, same routing as OOM (stays failing, owned by the regime refinement that lifts it; never EXCLUSIONS or a shape tagger).
